FARO

FARO SCENE

FARO SCENE supports processing, registering and managing terrestrial laser-scan projects.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Register scan stations

Use the selected scans, photographs or measured geometry and coordinate basis. In the intended FARO SCENE preview, register scan stations; the visible result is an aligned capture set with coverage and registration state visible. Review scale, overlap, control points and residual error before accepting or exporting it.

Filter and colour point clouds

Start from the cleaned capture and nominal reference. In the intended FARO SCENE preview, filter and colour point clouds; the visible result is a segmented, reconstructed or compared geometry result. Review noise, holes, alignment strategy and tolerance basis before accepting or exporting it.

Export a coordinated scan project

Begin with the reviewed mesh, surface, cloud or inspection characteristics. In the intended FARO SCENE preview, export a coordinated scan project; the visible result is an export or report tied to the captured source and coordinate system. Review deviation limits, completeness, units and downstream fitness before accepting or exporting it.
